bpmFix.title: Fix BPM Drift
bpmFix.ambiguityHint: Beat detection is ambiguous. Check the BPM and multiplier.
bpmFix.lossyHint: Lossy formats such as MP3 / AAC will be re-encoded.
bpmFix.invalidOptions: Check target BPM (30–300) and confirm each low-confidence song.
bpmFix.localBeatWarning: Overall beat checks passed, but {count} beats deviate locally. Give the result a listen to confirm.
bpmFix.stretchWarning: {count} segments require substantial stretching. Listen to confirm audio quality.
bpmFix.peakAdjusted: Overall gain was reduced to avoid clipping.
bpmFix.busy: A BPM drift repair session already exists. Restore it from the task bar.
bpmFix.outputExists: An audio file already exists at the destination. This song was not published.
bpmFix.lowConfidence: Automatic beat detection is uncertain. Check the target BPM and beat multiplier.
bpmFix.verificationFailed: A reliable drift correction could not be completed for this song. The original is unchanged.
bpmFix.extremeStretch: Some segments require excessive stretching. Processing was stopped.
bpmFix.sourceChanged: The original changed during processing. Close and analyze again.
bpmFix.runtimeHint: "Fix BPM Drift" needs the analysis runtime. It is not installed; install it and try again.
bpmFix.componentUpdateUnavailable: The current component does not support "Fix BPM Drift". Please try again later.
bpmFix.librosaUnavailable: The beat-checking components are incomplete. Update the analysis components and try again.
bpmFix.rendererUnavailable: Audio processing is unavailable. Repair or reinstall the app.
bpmFix.libraryBusy: Wait until the library merge finishes.
bpmFix.invalidPlaylist: The playlist or song location changed. Reopen the playlist and try again.
bpmFix.unsupportedFormat: Cannot retain this audio format. Choose WAV.
bpmFix.failedHint: Processing failed. Details were logged. Completed outputs are retained.
bpmFix.recoveryRequired: Another application occupied the original filename. The original audio is preserved in a recovery backup. See the log for its location.
bpmFix.analysisEvidence: Beat coverage {coverage} · Beat agreement {agreement} · Reference BPM {reference}
bpmFix.phaseDifferenceHint: The two detectors are offset by a fixed amount but agree on timing, so the reliability score already accounts for it.
bpmFix.lowConfidenceHint: Automatic beat detection is uncertain; this is not an audio-quality judgment. Check the target BPM and beat multiplier, then confirm below to try repair.
bpmFix.outputCleanupRequired: The original was restored or unchanged, but another application is holding an uncommitted output. See the log for its cleanup path.
bpmFix.verificationTempo: The measured output tempo differs from the target.
bpmFix.verificationDrift: Overall output beat deviations exceed the verification threshold.
bpmFix.verificationDetections: Verification found missing or extra beats. This can also be a detector error, so check the beats yourself.
bpmFix.notEnoughBeats: Too few valid beats were detected to plan drift correction. This is not an audio-quality judgment.
bpmFix.unreliableBeats: The detected beats could not form a reliable continuous beat sequence. This is not an audio-quality judgment.
bpmFix.automaticHint: Analyze and repair the selected songs automatically, without setting each BPM.
bpmFix.verificationAudio: There is not enough audio evidence to confirm beat alignment.
